entities.name: Théophane Ier de Constantinople
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Theophanes I of Constantinople was Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople from August 1596 to February 1597. He died only three weeks after leaving office. He was previously the metropolitan of Philippopolis, a protopsaltes and composer of hymns.
